generic_lessons: Versioned static control tools are consumers of the actual mod manifest. A version bump must update their explicit admissible versions and paired build assertions before claiming a complete suite pass.
Keep a failed complete test run intact, classify the common cause and rerun after the consumer correction. Do not rename an unsupported-version error as gameplay success.
Local helper declaration order and a runnable independent regression are prerequisites; compiling JSON patches or listing test names is insufficient.
A bounded route proposal should authorize only its real first native edge. Revalidate identity, position, formation, occupancy and threats after native qualification, and plan future hops afresh.
Strict distance progress can avoid same-goal backtracking loops but deliberately excludes some real detours. Document that scope instead of claiming complete routing.
